title: Continuous Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP) Therapy For Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA)
description: CMS National Coverage Determination for CPAP therapy in adult patients with obstructive sleep apnea (NCD 240.4).

change_log.author: CMS MCD Coverage API
change_log.summary: Transcribed from CMS NCD 240.4 via official Coverage API.

criteria.name: Documented AHI or RDI >= 15 Events/Hour (or >= 5 with Comorbidities)
criteria.description: Polysomnography or unattended home sleep monitoring confirming AHI or RDI >= 15 events per hour, or AHI/RDI between 5 and 14 with documented excessive daytime sleepiness, hypertension, or ischemic heart disease.
criteria.clinical_intent: Diagnostic severity threshold for obstructive sleep apnea
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report

criteria.name: Initial 12-Week Trial and Clinical Benefit Reassessment
criteria.description: Initial coverage is limited to a 12-week trial period; continued coverage requires documented clinical improvement and adherence.
criteria.clinical_intent: Verify adherence and symptom improvement during initial trial
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report

criteria.description: The provider of CPAP must conduct education of the beneficiary prior to the use of the CPAP device to ensure proper use.
